meta.title: pk.dev — websites, apps & 2D games | Patryk Kostecki
meta.description: Got an idea? Tell me about it. I build websites, apps and 2D games — from idea to launch and care after release.

hero.subtitle: Websites, apps and games — you tell me what you want to achieve, and I take care of everything else: design, code, launch and care after release.
hero.note: A quote and an action plan — free, usually within 24 hours.

services.title: One person. The whole project.
services.subtitle: You don't need to know how it works inside. You just need to know what you want to achieve.

cards.title: Websites
cards.text: Your business online: a fast, modern website that looks great on phones and is easy to find on Google.

cards.title: Web & mobile apps
cards.text: A tool tailored to your business or an app for Android and iPhone — from idea all the way to the app store.

cards.title: 2D games — also personalized
cards.text: A game starring you and your friends? Can do. Perfect as a gift, for an event, or just for fun.

cards.title: Care after launch
cards.text: I don't disappear after delivery. Updates, fixes and new features — your site or app is always looked after.

items.title: You write to me
items.text: A few sentences about what you need. No technical language — just describe the idea.

items.title: We agree on a plan
items.text: I propose a solution, timeline and price. Everything clear from the start, no surprises.

items.title: You receive the product
items.text: I build and show progress along the way. You get a working product at the end.

projects.title: Selected work
projects.subtitle: A website, an app and a game — three different worlds, one maker.

items.desc: An Alvernia Planet app that turns visitors' recordings into a finished Mars mission movie — from green screen to final edit on the phone.

contact.title: Tell me about your idea
contact.subtitle: Write a few sentences — what you want to build and why. I'll take care of the rest.

footer.tagline: Websites, apps and 2D games — from idea to launch and care after release.

items.a: Every project is priced individually after a short chat — a simple website is a different budget than an app or a game. You know the price before we start and it doesn't change.
A simple website usually takes 1–2 weeks, a bigger site or an app 4–8 weeks. You get a concrete deadline together with the quote and the plan.

items.q: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
items.a: Not at all. We talk like humans about what you want to achieve, and I handle the technical side: domain, hosting, deployment and security.
Nothing is left unattended. I can keep updating, fixing and growing your site or app — on an ongoing basis or whenever you need it.

about.title: Hi, I'm Patryk.
about.lead: Full-stack developer (Next.js) and Flutter. Since 2024 I've been building websites, apps and games — first at Capgemini, now at Alvernia Planet and for my own clients.
about.body: I like projects where the result is visible: a website that sells tickets, an app in the App Store, a game someone gets as a gift. I talk like a human, deliver on time and don't disappear after handover.

capgemini.text: Business process automation (Blue Prism, UiPath), Python and SQL for enterprise clients.

alvernia.text: The alverniaplanet.com website, the MarsApp iOS app and the park's internal tools.
